_note: VENDORED RATE CARD — the Estimator's live pricing card, copied into THE GOAT.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
calc_line() needs `rates`, `dayStart`, `nightStart` and `minBillableHours`, and
THE GOAT cannot reach the Estimator's Supabase project. This is a CAPTURE, not a
second source of truth: the Estimator's `rate_cards` and `app_settings` tables own
these numbers and this file is a dated snapshot of them.
It is NOT config.ts's `defaultConfig`. That is the stale pre-July card (Standard
Crew at 60.10/76.20/93.60) and pricing forward work from it would under-quote by
4.6-14.5%. These are the live values (Standard Crew 63.00/79.90/99.95).
STALENESS IS VISIBLE, NOT IMPLICIT
`captured_at` is reported through /api/performance and drawn on the chart key, so a
card that has not been refreshed since a known rate rise is obvious to the reader
rather than depending on someone remembering to check. The forward view is a
projection, so a card a few weeks stale is acceptable in a way a historical figure
never would be — but it has to be legible.
HOW TO REFRESH
Re-run the §6 probe against the Estimator project (jtsxnqfudaqxuqinhkut):
select role_name, day_rate, night_rate, sunday_rate, public_holiday_rate,
ot_8_day_rate, ot_10_day_rate, effective_from, sort_order, is_active
from rate_cards order by is_active desc, sort_order, effective_from;
then move `captured_at` and `source.rate_cards_last_change` with it.
COLUMN MAPPING — from serverConfig.ts loadAppConfigServer(), not inferred
over8  = ot_8_day_rate     over10 = ot_10_day_rate
The ot_8_night_rate / ot_10_night_rate columns exist and are DELIBERATELY UNUSED:
calc.ts prices an overtime hour at max(over8, night, sunday, publicHoliday), so the
night OT column would be double-counting the night rate it already maxes against.
PUBLIC HOLIDAYS ARE NOT HERE, ON PURPOSE
They come from SmartStaff's own per-call `is_pubhol` / `is_pubhol_tomorrow` flags,
which is the list operations actually maintains. Vendoring the Estimator's
`public_holidays` table would be a second list to drift.
